verdict.rationale: Make's webhook docs describe scheduling webhook processing so that queued requests are handled periodically rather than immediately (make-docs-6, make-docs-16, make-docs-21), which is a form of queuing/throttling for incoming triggers. However, there is no evidence of built-in mechanisms to throttle scenario execution rate or module-level API calls specifically to respect downstream service rate limits (e.g., no rate-limit-aware retry/backoff or execution concurrency controls documented). missing for 10: explicit rate-limit-aware execution throttling, concurrency/queue controls for outbound API calls, documentation on respecting third-party API limits.
